description: This file defines a singleton object 'PermissionsConstants' that contains constants and functions related to permission handling in an Android application. It includes preference keys, request flags, and group names for permissions management.

methods.name: keyRequested
methods.description: Generates a key string for permission request flags for a given permission group.

methods.name: keyOptIn
methods.description: Generates a key string for permission opt-in flags for a given permission group.
